versions.content: Existence of reference to DiagnosticParameterIdent in the role diagnosticParameter If the reference DiagnosticServiceDataMap- ping . diagnosticParameter exists, then the intention is to map a composite Dat- aPrototype to a DiagnosticParameter in one piece. This means that the elements of the composite DataPrototype would be placed one after the other starting at the bitOffset of the referenced DiagnosticParameter .
